label: Anchor likeability
description: Comments on the anchors or on-air talent as people: warmth, trust, delivery, voice, appearance, chemistry, credibility of a named or unnamed presenter.

label: Weather segment
description: Comments on the weather forecast or the meteorologist: accuracy, clarity, maps, radar, storm coverage, how long the forecast runs.

label: Pacing
description: Comments on the speed or rhythm of the broadcast: rushed, slow, dragging, choppy transitions, too many quick hits, stories cut short.

label: Crime coverage
description: Comments on crime, police, shootings, court or public-safety stories: too much, too little, sensational, fair, scary.

label: Graphics
description: Comments on on-screen visuals: graphics, lower thirds, tickers, set design, colors, text size, the look of the show.

label: Local relevance
description: Comments on whether stories matter to the viewer's own community: neighborhoods, schools, city council, local businesses, or national news crowding out local news.

label: Sports
description: Comments on the sports segment or sports anchor: scores, local teams, high school sports, amount of sports coverage.

label: Length
description: Comments on the overall length of the newscast or of the program as a whole: too long, too short, should be 30 or 60 minutes.

label: Commercials
description: Comments on commercial breaks or advertising: too many, too long, repetitive ads, breaks at bad moments.

label: Comparison to other stations
description: Explicit comparison with another station, channel, network or news source, or a statement about switching or preferring one.

label: Nothing / no opinion
description: No substantive opinion: did not watch, don't know, no comment, nothing to say, or a non-answer.

label: Other
description: A substantive opinion that fits none of the codes above.
